checks: Initial markup disables premature detection and removes the same-network requirement
Resets and forced clicks cannot send an IR command during initial registration
Wi-Fi Connected and form edits cannot imply cloud success or erase a failure
Registered controller Edit still learns a real result and releases its controls
Learning failures retain their actionable cloud error instead of a local-network instruction
Saving remains Verifying until the asynchronous cloud registration confirms
Repeated Submit and closing the modal cannot race the active registration
Cloud success and local persistence complete before the verified message and close
Missing migration or rejected registration stays incomplete and allows retry
A failed registration can be retried successfully
Local persistence failure cannot produce a completed registration UI
Optional brand-profile saving remains guarded against duplicate registrations
Optional profile failure releases the save guard and keeps its error visible
Skipped Wi-Fi setup can register with the repair password and still waits for the cloud heartbeat
Choosing an existing AC passes its actual ID and exact saved IR variant through the registration handler
A rejected custom room stays out of the shared cache; retry creates and confirms it before cloud registration
Controller Edit confirms custom building, floor, and room before linking; rejected locations leave metadata unchanged and allow retry
Missing device lookup explains cloud registration instead of falsely blaming Bluetooth
